title: Sanad engine 0.2.0 (unreleased) added to the repository
summary: The engine runs an assessment end to end: templates, blind commit and reveal, evidence chain, sealed credential, transparency log and verification under the verifier's own policy. Algorithm sanad-0.1 is unchanged. It has had no external cryptographic review.

title: Reference implementation and test vectors published
summary: The repository contains a dependency-free reference implementation, 15 recognition vectors and 5 inference vectors, and a command-line verifier (node reference/verify.mjs).

title: Specification v0.1 published
summary: The first version of the Sanad specification (data model, recognition function, transparency log, privacy and threats) is published and open for comment.

title: Name and legal form decided
summary: The protocol is called Sanad. The Open Sanad Foundation is to be established in the United Arab Emirates; until it exists, Dr. Arash Kermani Kolankeh acts as interim steward.

title: Website published
summary: sanadprotocol.org is online in English and German. It uses no cookies, no analytics and no external requests.
